**Finding: deviation (GOVLAW)**

Section 28.1 selects Singapore law with exclusive Singapore courts — outside the accepted list and near our walk-away position (foreign law with exclusive foreign venue). It also conflicts directly with Section 28.2, which already vests exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County.

Redline (validated, ok:true): in 28.1, replace "governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction" with "governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules" — the smallest edit that reaches our preferred position while preserving 28.2's venue and 28.3's escalation process. Fallback offered in the comment: Delaware/California, or England and Wales with London courts.
